segments.summary: Reviewed all worktree, compare, create, focus-lineage, list, lock, and open rows. The template supplies dispatcher, projected-state, receipt, accessibility, and regression contracts, while payload schemas, mutation lifecycle, recovery, authority, and path trust remain unspecified.

Reviewed all open-files, prune, recover, release, remove, request-prune, and reuse rows. Wiring evidence is systematic, but destructive safeguards, the prune/request-prune distinction, and recovery state and oracle semantics are absent.

Reviewed worktree select, switch, unlock and GitHub Actions cancel, compare-last-success, dispatch, and open-current-branch. Compare authority is explicitly constrained, while cancel safety, compatibility alias behavior, and remote failure states are not.

Reviewed open-in-GitHub, open-job, related-diff, related-worktree, open-run, legacy open-run-diff, and canonical open-run-diff. Navigation wiring is explicit, but destination trust, outcome states, and conflicting alias normalization remain unresolved.

Reviewed open-run-in-browser, run-log, step-logs, pin, pin-workflow, rerun-workflow, and settings-open. The production wiring template is present, while log privacy, pin persistence, rerun authority and idempotency, remote reconciliation, and scale limits are not.
